description.zh:
快照的描述。长度为2~256个英文或中文字符，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。

默认值：空。
description.en:
The description of the snapshot. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

Default value: empty.

description.zh: 所属的地域ID。您可以调用DescribeRegions查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region. Call DescribeRegions to query the latest list of Alibaba Cloud regions.

description.zh:
快照的显示名称。长度为2~128个英文或中文字符。必须以大小字母或中文开头，不能以`http://`和`https://`开头。可以包含数字、半角冒号（:）、下划线（_）或者连字符（-）。

为防止和自动快照的名称冲突，不能以auto开头和dbfs-auto开头。
description.en:
The display name of the snapshot. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. The name can contain English or Chinese characters, digits, colons (:), underscores (\_), and hyphens (-).

To prevent conflicts with automatic snapshot names, the name cannot start with auto or dbfs-auto.
